51538279.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human recombinant HIF-2alpha (240 to 350 residues) assessed as as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. The protein (HIF-2α PAS-B domain, 240–350 residues) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.4, and concentrated to 100 μM. The ligand was dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 1–2 mM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The heat of dilution was determined by titrating the ligand into buffer and subtracted from the raw data. The dissociation constant (Kd) was calculated from the binding isotherm.
